description: Token emission and unlock schedule per allocation label (team, investors, rewards, etc.) from DefiLlama emissions data, by protocol slug: last unlock day and amount, next scheduled unlock (if any in the data), and total unlocked to date. Amounts are in tokens. Coverage depends on DefiLlama having the protocol's emissions file. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
